units.source_text: 阿清勉强支起身子，下决心自杀了。

en.t: Aqing forced herself to sit up and resolved to kill herself.

units.source_text: 不，“下决心自杀”这句话在她脑子里的回响并不那么强烈，

en.t: No, the phrase "resolved to kill herself" did not echo so strongly in her mind,
in truth, she had fallen into despair.

units.source_text: 从结果来看，她接待筑路工人本身就是一种自杀。

en.t: Judging by the outcome, her receiving the road workers was itself a kind of suicide.
